title: Thrissur bar owner booked for serving drinks to 17-year-old
content: A case has been registered against the owner of a bar in Mannuthy, Thrissur, on Tuesday for allegedly serving drinks to a 17-year-old boy, police said. According to Mannuthy police, it came to light that the boy was underage after he got into a fight at the Mayura bar. Following the incident, the boy's mother approached the police station and filed a complaint against the bar owner. Further investigation is underway.
